The Art of the Handmade

Made from wood that has already lived.

Every Konge mirror begins as reclaimed timber with a history of its own. We cut it into triangles, sort them by grain and tone, and fit them by hand until the frame becomes a pattern you can read from across a room.

No moulds. No repeats. Because each piece is built one at a time, the one you hang is the only one like it.

Reclaimed timber

Wood with a past, given a second life as a frame.

Cut by hand

Every triangle is cut, sorted by grain and fitted individually.

Made to order

One piece at a time in Nairobi. Three to fourteen days, depending on the piece.
